reasoning: The agent clearly factored shared infrastructure (parser, S3/NC scorer, generic configurable aligner) from per-instance tuning, marked every milestone with its numeric bar (0.55/0.30/0.32), and deliberately sequenced the two deliverables — matching anchor 8. It also shows anchor-10 traits: treating the optimization loop as its own checkpointed sub-goal and adapting investment toward the harder DM-HS target as intermediate scores revealed the gap. It falls short of a full 10 because the ordering rationale wasn't framed as easy-vs-hard and the late reheating rounds were repetitive rather than fresh re-decomposition, so I place it at 8.
